h.select_rule: Discard any hypothesis whose condition is the edited field's own current value, or whose condition merely disables or disconnects the edited component. From the rest, keep 10 with distinct mechanisms and field pairs, favouring those where an informed expert could plausibly bet on either direction.
h.strategy: Two patterns are banned because experts find them obvious: (1) conditioning on the current value of the same field being edited, which just restates that upgrading a weak setting helps more than upgrading a strong one; (2) conditions that make the edited component unused, unreachable or inert. Instead, each hypothesis must link two DIFFERENT fields that interact through a non-trivial mechanism, such as substitution between parallel routes, a capacity already supplied elsewhere, one part acting as a bottleneck for another, or interference that turns a usually helpful edit harmful. No condition setting may appear in more than two hypotheses. Use the gaps and negated assumptions as the source of each idea. In each 'why', name the mechanism and explain why the opposite direction is also a priori plausible.

hyps.why: With a direct 0->3 conv already feeding the output, a 2->3 conv adds partly redundant conv capacity at the output node, so its marginal gain shrinks.
With 3x3 spatial context already reaching the output via 1->3, a cheap 1x1 channel-mixing path on 2->3 is complementary rather than inferior.
Node 2 already receives conv features via 1->2, so a parallel 0->2 conv shows saturated returns.
An identity 0->3 shortcut gives the cell a residual form, so the deeper 0->1->2->3 conv chain is easier to train and more useful.
With 0->2 removed, 1->2 is node 2's only input, so an identity there un-starves node 2 rather than just adding a redundant path.
A skip on 1->2 makes node 2 closer to raw input, so pooling it into the output injects blurred low-level signal that hurts more.
An identity 0->3 complements a deep conv route ending at 2->3, forming a residual block that trains and generalizes better.
With a deep 0->1->2 conv chain present, the 0->3 edge is most valuable as a short route, so filling it with another conv helps less.
With 0->1 an identity, pooling on 1->3 merely blurs the raw input into the output, which is more damaging than smoothing learned features.
Without 2->3, the 1->3 edge is one of only two routes into the output, so making it a conv carries much more of the cell's capacity.
